about_short_description.short_description: Brands for Less is an online store that sells jackets, jeans, footwear, leggings, bleeding, toys, t-shirts, and other related accessories.

product.name: Jackets
product.description: Clothing items designed to provide warmth and protection, typically worn over other garments.

product.name: Jeans
product.description: Denim pants designed for casual wear, offering durability and comfort.

product.name: Footwear
product.description: Various types of shoes and related accessories for different occasions and uses.

product.name: Leggings
product.description: Stretchable close-fitting pants typically worn for comfort or athletic purposes.

product.name: T-shirts
product.description: Casual upper-body garments made from soft fabric, suitable for everyday wear.

product.name: Toys
product.description: Items designed for play and entertainment, suitable for children.
